title: Young
html_source:
Stephen poured them all more booze and dedicated it to the pope who he maintained is both the Vicar of Bray and Christ.

Joyce lived in Bray as a kid – it was the first stop on the slide to the northside. You can still see the house now, at the north end of the Bray seafront.

Bray is a knackered 1950s seaside resort and where this shamateur Joyce scholar went to school. God bless Presentation College Bray.
